name: Hosokawa Micron Corporation
summary: Hosokawa Micron Corporation provides powder and plastic processing equipment in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. The company offers powder processing equipment for grinding, classifying, blending and drying powder materials and products used in various industries; dust collection equipment for environmental protection and product recovery; and chemical hazard prevention equipment for the protection of workers during pharmaceuticals development and manufacture. It also provides machines for milling, mixing, particle design, agglomeration, feed and discharge, laboratory technology, bag filters, protection and production isolation, and engineering, as well as after-sales,…
